title: Linear Entropy and Rank Inequalities for Quantum Marginals
exact_target: Find the linear constraints on quantum marginal entropies and ranks, including the named entropy family and the indicated tripartite rank bound.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30003811 (OWR-16163-014). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Interactions between Operator Space Theory and Quantum Probability with Applications to Quantum Information (2018), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2018/22, pp. 1293--1379. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 82.

status_qualification: The named higher-order entropy family is source-defined. The rank inequality concerns a tripartite reduced state and is not an inequality between arbitrary unrelated matrices. Fresh status review of each component has not been established by this statement preparation.
